Name: Charlie Out Of Her Coop
Author: PeepCake
Description:
[size=3]Are you concerned about Shane's favorite hen only getting sunlight on Saturdays, if at all?

Worry no more, because now you can find Charlie roosting next to her coop on sunny days![/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6986/6986-1602334211-511112528.gif[/img]

This is currently just a cosmetic change, so Charlie is not interactive and doesn't move around.
Only works if you're married to Shane, if that wasn't obvious. She is set to appear only on non-winter days when it's not raining.

Downloads.Description: Now compatible with the beach farm.

Manifest.Name: CharlieTheChicken
Manifest.Description: Charlie appears on farm if player is married to Shane.
